headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of August 11, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 25.78% compared to SPY's 13.81%. This results in an average alpha of 11.97%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a remarkable return of 48.30%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', still shows a positive return of 16.76%, demonstrating resilience across the portfolio set. This outperformance is particularly relevant during periods of market uncertainty, as it reflects the portfolio's ability to navigate challenging conditions effectively. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
